title: Pop Art
look: A 1960s pop canvas: giant Ben-Day dots, flat primaries, a thick black line and a white speech burst on cyan.

doc.essence: A comic frame blown up to gallery size and repainted by hand: the printing dots become huge and deliberate, the colours are straight from the tube, and a jagged white balloon shouts behind.
doc.notIt: Not comic (dots on a white ground, only primaries, flat cyan and pink grounds, a speech balloon instead of a sunburst), not riso (black line, no misregistration), not bauhaus (dots, line, a balloon).
doc.shapes: A thick black line on every part, squarer corners, bold brows and a wide mouth.
doc.colour: Areas snap to red, yellow, blue, pink, green or white. The body is printed as big coloured dots on white; the rest is flat.
doc.eyes: Solid black with a white glint.
pitfalls: Big dots behind small eyes flicker at small sizes: the dot screen stays coarser than the eyes.
Body and accent snapping to the same primary merge: the line keeps them apart.
